name: edge-light
title: Edge Light
description: A pointer-aware highlight that stays on the nearest edge and falls back to a stable keyboard-focus treatment.

accessibility.notes: Pointer tracking is enabled only for fine hover pointers. Focus-within shows the same boundary immediately, and reduced motion keeps it fixed.

performance.budget: Bounds are invalidated on entry, scroll, resize, font loading, and nearby layout mutations, then measured before the next pointer paint; movement updates two variables on one isolated overlay at most once per frame.
